results.rationale: Consistency: The white background, front view, waistband, button, belt loops, pockets and two-leg design remain recognizable, but the garment geometry changes visibly: its outline shifts left, the hems end higher, and the fly is reshaped. The requested color change is excluded. Instruction: 1. Cream fabric becomes saturated blue. 2. Expected: the pants colored blue throughout. 3. Both legs and waistband are fully blue. 4. Perfect compliance. Quality: Structure ✔, natural lighting and folds ✔, artifact-free edges ✔, fabric texture ✔; the edited product image is coherent without noticeable defects.
